verses.original: וַיְשִׁבֵנִי֮ אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּיִת֒ וְהִנֵּה־ מַ֣יִם יֹצְאִ֗ים מִתַּ֨חַת מִפְתַּ֤ן הַבַּ֙יִת֙ קָדִ֔ימָה כִּֽי־ הַבַּ֖יִת פְנֵ֥י קָדִ֑ים וְהַמַּ֣יִם יֹרְדִ֗ים מִתַּ֜חַת הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִכֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ši·ḇê·nî ’el- pe·ṯaḥ hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hin·nêh- ma·yim yō·ṣə·’îm mit·ta·ḥaṯ mip̄·tan hab·ba·yiṯ qā·ḏî·māh kî- hab·ba·yiṯ p̄ə·nê qā·ḏîm wə·ham·ma·yim yō·rə·ḏîm mit·ta·ḥaṯ hay·mā·nîṯ mik·ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ min·ne·ḡeḇ lam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then [the man] brought me back to the entrance of the temple and I saw water flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east for the temple faced east The water was coming down from under the south side of the temple south of the altar

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִאֵנִי֮ דֶּֽרֶךְ־ צָפוֹנָה֒ שַׁ֣עַר וַיְסִבֵּ֙נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ ח֔וּץ אֶל־ הַח֔וּץ דֶּ֖רֶךְ שַׁ֣עַר הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה קָדִ֑ים וְהִנֵּה־ מַ֣יִם מְפַכִּ֔ים מִן־ הַיְמָנִֽית׃ הַכָּתֵ֖ף
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣi·’ê·nî de·reḵ- ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ša·‘ar way·sib·bê·nî de·reḵ ḥūṣ ’el- ha·ḥūṣ de·reḵ ša·‘ar hap·pō·w·neh qā·ḏîm wə·hin·nêh- ma·yim mə·p̄ak·kîm min- hay·mā·nîṯ hak·kā·ṯêp̄
verses.literal: Next he brought me out through the north gate and led me around . . . the outside to the outer . . . gate facing east and there I saw the water trickling out from the south side

verses.original: הָאִ֥ישׁ בְּצֵאת־ קָדִ֖ים וְקָ֣ו בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֤מָד אֶ֙לֶף֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֥נִי מֵ֥י אָפְסָֽיִם׃ בַמַּ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš bə·ṣêṯ- qā·ḏîm wə·qāw bə·yā·ḏōw way·yā·māḏ ’e·lep̄ bā·’am·māh way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nî mê ’ā·p̄ə·sā·yim ḇam·ma·yim
verses.literal: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through - ankle-deep water

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֥נִי בִּרְכָּ֑יִם בַמַּ֖יִם מַ֣יִם וַיָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֖נִי מָתְנָֽיִם׃ מֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’e·lep̄ way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nî bir·kā·yim ḇam·ma·yim ma·yim way·yā·māḏ ’e·lep̄ way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nî mā·ṯə·nā·yim mê
verses.literal: Then he measured off a thousand [cubits] and led me through knee-deep water vvv Again he measured a thousand [cubits] and led me through waist-deep water

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף נַ֕חַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אוּכַ֖ל לֹֽא־ לַעֲבֹ֑ר כִּֽי־ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ גָא֤וּ מֵ֣י שָׂ֔חוּ נַ֖חַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יֵעָבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’e·lep̄ na·ḥal ’ă·šer ’ū·ḵal lō- la·‘ă·ḇōr kî- ham·ma·yim ḡā·’ū mê śā·ḥū na·ḥal ’ă·šer lō- yê·‘ā·ḇêr
verses.literal: Once again he measured off a thousand [cubits] but now it was a river that I could not cross because the water had risen [and] was deep enough for swimming a river that could not be crossed on foot

verses.original: בֶן־ אָדָ֑ם הֲרָאִ֣יתָ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֖י וַיּוֹלִכֵ֥נִי וַיְשִׁבֵ֖נִי שְׂפַ֥ת הַנָּֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hă·rā·’î·ṯā way·yō·mer ’ê·lay way·yō·w·li·ḵê·nî way·ši·ḇê·nî śə·p̄aṯ han·nā·ḥal
verses.literal: Son of man do you see this he asked . . . Then he led me back to the bank of the river

verses.original: בְּשׁוּבֵ֕נִי וְהִנֵּה֙ אֶל־ מְאֹ֑ד רַ֣ב עֵ֖ץ מִזֶּ֖ה וּמִזֶּֽה׃ שְׂפַ֣ת הַנַּ֔חַל
verses.transliteration: bə·šū·ḇê·nî wə·hin·nêh ’el- mə·’ōḏ raḇ ‘êṣ miz·zeh ū·miz·zeh śə·p̄aṯ han·na·ḥal
verses.literal: When I arrived I saw . . . a great number of trees along both . . . banks of the river

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַמַּ֤יִם יוֹצְאִ֗ים אֶל־ הַקַּדְמוֹנָ֔ה הַגְּלִילָה֙ וְיָרְד֖וּ עַל־ הָֽעֲרָבָ֑ה וּבָ֣אוּ אֶל־ הַיָּ֔מָּה הַיָּ֥מָּה הַמּֽוּצָאִ֖ים הַמָּֽיִם׃ וְנִרְפְּאוּ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay hā·’êl·leh ham·ma·yim yō·wṣ·’îm ’el- haq·qaḏ·mō·w·nāh hag·gə·lî·lāh wə·yā·rə·ḏū ‘al- hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ū·ḇā·’ū ’el- hay·yām·māh hay·yām·māh ham·mū·ṣā·’îm ham·mā·yim wə·nir·pə·ʾū
verses.literal: And he said to me This water flows out to the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah When it empties into the [Dead] Sea vvv . . . the water there becomes fresh

verses.original: אֶ֣ל כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר֩ נַחֲלַ֙יִם֙ שָׁ֤ם יָב֨וֹא וְהָיָ֣ה כָל־ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יִשְׁרֹ֡ץ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֣ה׀ יִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד הַדָּגָ֖ה כִּי֩ הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַמַּ֣יִם בָ֨אוּ שָׁ֜מָּה וְיֵרָֽפְאוּ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ הַנָּֽחַל׃ יָ֥בוֹא כֹּ֛ל שָׁ֖מָּה וָחָ֔י
verses.transliteration: ’el kāl- ’ă·šer na·ḥă·la·yim šām yā·ḇō·w wə·hā·yāh ḵāl ’ăšer- yiš·rōṣ ne·p̄eš ḥay·yāh yiḥ·yeh wə·hā·yāh rab·bāh mə·’ōḏ had·dā·ḡāh kî hā·’êl·leh ham·ma·yim ḇā·’ū šām·māh wə·yê·rā·p̄ə·’ū ’ă·šer- han·nā·ḥal yā·ḇō·w kōl šām·māh wā·ḥāy
verses.literal: Wherever . . . - the river - flows there will be vvv vvv swarms of living creatures - [and] a great number of . . . fish because - [it] flows there and makes the waters fresh so wherever the river flows everything - will flourish

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ דַּוָּגִ֗ים מֵעֵ֥ין יַעַמְדוּ עָלָ֜יו גֶּ֙דִי֙ וְעַד־ עֵ֣ין עֶגְלַ֔יִם יִהְי֑וּ מִשְׁט֥וֹחַ לַֽחֲרָמִ֖ים דְגָתָ֔ם רַבָּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃ לְמִינָה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה כִּדְגַ֛ת הַגָּד֖וֹל הַיָּ֥ם
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh daw·wā·ḡîm mê·‘ên ya·ʿam·ḏū ‘ā·lāw ge·ḏî wə·‘aḏ- ‘ên ‘eḡ·la·yim yih·yū miš·ṭō·w·aḥ la·ḥă·rā·mîm ḏə·ḡā·ṯām rab·bāh mə·’ōḏ lə·mî·nāh tih·yeh kiḏ·ḡaṯ hag·gā·ḏō·wl hay·yām
verses.literal: Fishermen will stand by the shore from En-gedi to vvv En-eglaim they will spread their nets [to catch] fish of many . . . kinds . . . like the fish of the Great Sea

verses.original: בִּצֹּאתוֹ וּגְבָאָ֛יו וְלֹ֥א יֵרָפְא֖וּ נִתָּֽנוּ׃ לְמֶ֥לַח
verses.transliteration: biṣ·ṣō·ṯō ū·ḡə·ḇā·’āw wə·lō yê·rā·p̄ə·’ū nit·tā·nū lə·me·laḥ
verses.literal: But the swamps and marshes will not become fresh they will be left for salt

verses.original: וְעַל־ עַל־ מִזֶּ֣ה׀ וּמִזֶּ֣ה׀ שְׂפָת֣וֹ הַנַּ֣חַל מַ֠אֲכָל עֵֽץ־ כָּל־ יַעֲלֶ֣ה עָלֵ֜הוּ לֹא־ יִבּ֨וֹל פִּרְי֗וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יִתֹּ֣ם לָֽחֳדָשָׁיו֙ יְבַכֵּ֔ר כִּ֣י מֵימָ֔יו מִן־ הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ יֽוֹצְאִ֑ים הֵ֣מָּה פִרְיוֹ֙ וְהָיוּ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל וְעָלֵ֖הוּ לִתְרוּפָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ‘al- miz·zeh ū·miz·zeh śə·p̄ā·ṯōw han·na·ḥal ma·’ă·ḵāl ‘êṣ- kāl- ya·‘ă·leh ‘ā·lê·hū lō- yib·bō·wl pir·yōw wə·lō- yit·tōm lā·ḥo·ḏā·šāw yə·ḇak·kêr kî mê·māw min- ham·miq·dāš yō·wṣ·’îm hêm·māh p̄ir·yōw wə·hå̄·yū lə·ma·’ă·ḵāl wə·‘ā·lê·hū liṯ·rū·p̄āh
verses.literal: Along . . . both . . . banks of the river fruit trees of all kinds will grow Their leaves will not wither and their fruit will not fail Each month they will bear fruit because the water from the sanctuary flows to them . . . Their fruit will be used for food and their leaves for healing

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ גֵּ֤ה גְבוּל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ תִּתְנַחֲל֣וּ אֶת־ לִשְׁנֵ֥י עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יוֹסֵ֖ף חֲבָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar gêh ḡə·ḇūl ’ă·šer hā·’ā·reṣ tiṯ·na·ḥă·lū ’eṯ- liš·nê ‘ā·śār šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl yō·w·sêp̄ ḥă·ḇā·lîm
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says These [are] the boundaries by which you are to divide the land as an inheritance - among the twelve . . . tribes of Israel Joseph shall receive two portions

verses.original: וּנְחַלְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָהּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ כְּאָחִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לְתִתָּ֖הּ לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם הַזֹּ֛את הָאָ֧רֶץ וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה לָכֶ֖ם בְּנַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ḥal·tem ’ō·w·ṯāh ’îš kə·’ā·ḥîw ’ă·šer nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî lə·ṯit·tāh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh lā·ḵem bə·na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: You are to divide it equally among them Because I swore with an uplifted - hand to give it to your forefathers this land will fall to you as an inheritance

verses.original: וְזֶ֖ה גְּב֣וּל הָאָ֑רֶץ צָפ֜וֹנָה לִפְאַ֨ת מִן־ הַגָּד֛וֹל הַיָּ֧ם הַדֶּ֥רֶךְ חֶתְלֹ֖ן לְב֥וֹא צְדָֽדָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh gə·ḇūl hā·’ā·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh lip̄·’aṯ min- hag·gā·ḏō·wl hay·yām had·de·reḵ ḥeṯ·lōn lə·ḇō·w ṣə·ḏā·ḏāh
verses.literal: This [shall be] the boundary of the land On the north side it will extend from the Great Sea by way of Hethlon through Lebo-hamath to Zedad

verses.original: חֲמָ֤ת׀ בֵּר֙וֹתָה֙ סִבְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁר֙ בֵּין־ גְּב֣וּל דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וּבֵ֖ין גְּב֣וּל חֲמָ֑ת חָצֵר֙ הַתִּיכ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל חַוְרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·māṯ bê·rō·w·ṯāh siḇ·ra·yim ’ă·šer bên- gə·ḇūl dam·me·śeq ū·ḇên gə·ḇūl ḥă·māṯ ḥā·ṣêr hat·tî·ḵō·wn ’ă·šer ’el- gə·ḇūl ḥaw·rān
verses.literal: - Berothah and Sibraim (which [is] on the border between Damascus . . . [and] Hamath vvv as far as Hazer-hatticon which is on the border of Hauran

verses.original: גְב֜וּל וְהָיָ֨ה מִן־ הַיָּ֗ם חֲצַ֤ר עֵינוֹן֙ צָפ֖וֹנָה גְּב֣וּל דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וּגְב֣וּל חֲמָ֑ת וְאֵ֖ת וְצָפ֥וֹן׀ צָפֽוֹן׃ פְּאַ֥ת
verses.transliteration: ḡə·ḇūl wə·hā·yāh min- hay·yām ḥă·ṣar ‘ê·nō·wn ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh gə·ḇūl dam·me·śeq ū·ḡə·ḇūl ḥă·māṯ wə·’êṯ wə·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ṣā·p̄ō·wn pə·’aṯ
verses.literal: So the border will run from the Sea vvv to Hazar-enan along the northern border of Damascus with the territory of Hamath - to the north [This] [will be] the northern boundary

verses.original: קָדִ֡ים וּפְאַ֣ת מִגְּב֛וּל מִבֵּ֣ין חַוְרָ֣ן וּמִבֵּין־ דַּמֶּשֶׂק֩ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וּמִבֵּ֨ין הַגִּלְעָ֜ד וּמִבֵּ֨ין אֶ֤רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל־ הַקַּדְמוֹנִ֖י הַיָּ֥ם וְאֵ֖ת תָּמֹ֑דּוּ קָדִֽימָה׃ פְּאַ֥ת
verses.transliteration: qā·ḏîm ū·p̄ə·’aṯ mig·gə·ḇūl mib·bên ḥaw·rān ū·mib·bên- dam·me·śeq hay·yar·dên ū·mib·bên hag·gil·‘āḏ ū·mib·bên ’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- haq·qaḏ·mō·w·nî hay·yām wə·’êṯ tā·mōd·dū qā·ḏî·māh pə·’aṯ
verses.literal: On the east side the border will run between Hauran and Damascus along the Jordan between Gilead . . . and the land of Israel to the Eastern Sea and as far as Tamar This will be the eastern boundary

verses.original: נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֔נָה וּפְאַת֙ מִתָּמָ֗ר עַד־ מֵי֙ מְרִיב֣וֹת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה אֶל־ הַגָּד֑וֹל הַיָּ֣ם וְאֵ֥ת תֵּימָ֖נָה נֶֽגְבָּה׃ פְּאַת־
verses.transliteration: ne·ḡeḇ tê·mā·nāh ū·p̄ə·’aṯ mit·tā·mār ‘aḏ- mê mə·rî·ḇō·wṯ qā·ḏêš na·ḥă·lāh ’el- hag·gā·ḏō·wl hay·yām wə·’êṯ tê·mā·nāh neḡ·bāh pə·’aṯ-
verses.literal: On the south . . . side it will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh . . . and along the Brook [of Egypt] to the Great Sea - vvv This will be the southern boundary

verses.original: יָם֙ וּפְאַת־ הַגָּד֔וֹל הַיָּ֣ם מִגְּב֕וּל עַד־ נֹ֖כַח לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת זֹ֖את יָֽם׃ פְּאַת־
verses.transliteration: yām ū·p̄ə·’aṯ- hag·gā·ḏō·wl hay·yām mig·gə·ḇūl ‘aḏ- nō·ḵaḥ lə·ḇō·w ḥă·māṯ zōṯ yām pə·’aṯ-
verses.literal: And on the west side the Great Sea will be the boundary up to a point opposite Lebo-hamath . . . This will be the western boundary

verses.original: וְחִלַּקְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־ הַזֹּ֛את הָאָ֧רֶץ לָכֶ֖ם לְשִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥil·laq·tem ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lā·ḵem lə·šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You are to divide - this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה תַּפִּ֣לוּ אוֹתָהּ֮ בְּנַחֲלָה֒ לָכֶ֗ם וּלְהַגֵּרִים֙ הַגָּרִ֣ים בְּתוֹכְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹלִ֥דוּ בָנִ֖ים בְּתֽוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְהָי֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם כְּאֶזְרָח֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִתְּכֶם֙ יִפְּל֣וּ בְנַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh tap·pi·lū ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·na·ḥă·lāh lā·ḵem ū·lə·hag·gê·rîm hag·gā·rîm bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem ’ă·šer- hō·w·li·ḏū ḇā·nîm bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem wə·hā·yū lā·ḵem kə·’ez·rāḥ biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’it·tə·ḵem yip·pə·lū ḇə·na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: vvv You shall allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners who dwell among you and who have children - You are to treat them . . . as native-born Israelites . . . along with you they shall be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ בַשֵּׁ֔בֶט הַגֵּ֖ר אִתּ֑וֹ גָּ֥ר תִּתְּנ֣וּ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ שָׁ֚ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ă·šer- ḇaš·šê·ḇeṭ hag·gêr ’it·tōw gār tit·tə·nū na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw šām nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: - In whatever tribe a foreigner . . . dwells you are to assign his inheritance there declares the Lord GOD
